title: The explicit supported finite scalar model derived hull
statement: Let Lambda be a commutative condensed ring, and let X be a scheme, with the module category A_X over its pulled-back coefficient ring [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull]. Use the ordinary derived category D(A_X) [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] in the fixed small-site universe [def-weil-size-convention]. A support path is a path in a finite qcqs open-closed tree [def-sfb-qcqs-open-closed-tree], using actual open extension by zero and closed direct image. A finite scalar local model is as in [sk-def-sfb-constructible]. Define IsSupportedImageGenerationClass(Lambda,X,P) by these six requirements on a class P of derived objects: (1) P is triangulated (contains zero, is closed under all integer shifts and distinguished-triangle extensions); (2) P is closed under isomorphisms; (3) for maps K -> L -> K whose composite is the identity, P(L) implies P(K); (4) for every small family K_i and limiting product cone c, if P(K_i) holds for all i then P(c.pt); (5) for every support path p:S->X and every finite scalar local model L on S, P((p.extension L)[0]); (6) for every small filtered strict diagram D of cochain complexes and colimiting cocone c, if all D_i vanish termwise below a common integer a and every Q(D_i) belongs to P, then Q(c.pt) belongs to P. Products and termwise filtered colimits use the actual universal properties [def-weil-category-product, def-weil-pbc-category-colimit], and Q is localization. Define supportedImageGenerationHull(Lambda,X,K) to mean P(K) for every such P. These are the unchanged two definitions extracted from the image-generation module; no closure condition is added or omitted.
